title: SwagBot Hub
features:
SwagBot Hub is a premium, feature‑rich AI chatbot for Roblox. Written in Lua for executor environments, it listens to in‑game chat and responds with human‑like intelligence using either Groq (free, built‑in keys) or OpenAI / ChatGPT (your own API key). The bot comes with fully customizable personalities.

AI chatbot and auto-reply system for Roblox chat
Toggle the UI anytime with P
Custom personality presets and custom prompts
Optional per-user memory so conversations stay separated
Proximity and range filtering
Selective player mode
Moderation tools with blacklist and timeouts
Follow automation with pathfinding or direct movement
Local config saving and loading
Configurable AI provider, model, temperature, and response delay
Free Work.ink key system with saved keys
Official Discord invite copied on launch
